g.text: At this epoch, complexes 2-5 retain independent population networks. The coastal and mountain rim continues through

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #536a6e

g.text: connected mixed successors, not disappearance of its people or cultures.

svg.title: Regional contact of Erde
svg.desc: Five regional population complexes and their successor communities about five thousand years before the present. Equal-area view. The Great Watersheds, Volcanic Hinge, Highland Spine and Equatorial Basin retain self-sustaining networks. Coastal and mountain-rim communities continue through mixed successors.
